summary: Settings panel silently resets the SERVER models root when the stored path contains temp/tmp. Guard at MpiSettings.js:348-354 fires on MOUNT and calls _setComfyPath(''), which rewrites extra_model_paths.yaml to the default root - the single source of truth - and /comfy/set-path logs nothing on success. Hit live: G:/CubricModels (144GB) orphaned, no log line, 1.75GB re-downloaded. Substring match means it ships to any user whose models path contains those letters.

Guard deleted (it was redundant - _hydrateComfyPath already reconciles from the YAML), set-path now logs old -> new root on both branches. Suite 282/282, both test halves negative-controlled against HEAD. Sweep clean: every other _setComfyPath call site is user-initiated.
maturity planned -> validating; attention required for the one live restart check.
